Camera: requested when you start QR/barcode scanning. Generation and image selection remain available if declined. You can revoke access in system settings.

Internet: used for the catalog, accounts, sync, announcements, recommendations, feedback, AI, web tools and network diagnostics. AI needs separate consent before sending text; cloud sync is off by default.

Network state: dependency components check connectivity. This does not provide location access.

Files: the system picker grants access to selected images/documents. You choose export destinations; sharing grants temporary file URI access. No broad storage permission is required.

The app does not request location, microphone, contacts, phone or broad storage access. Contact, calendar and Wi-Fi codes are imported by another app you choose. AndroidX’s app-internal signature permission protects receivers and does not read other apps’ data.

Version 0.1.0 · 2026-10-11
湖北花海网络科技有限公司
Contact: 14329140@qq.com

Basic tools work anonymously. Text, selected images, QR codes and device information are processed locally by default. Copying, saving and sharing are your choices. Camera access is requested only for scanning; system pickers grant file access. No location, microphone, contacts, phone or broad storage permissions, advertising or automatic third-party analytics SDKs.

Favorites, recents and preferences are local. Cloud sync is off by default; enabling it sends the corresponding data and a random sync device ID, excluding images and QR contents. QR history is off by default, limited to 100 entries, excludes Wi-Fi/OTP and supports deletion.

Accounts use email, nickname and password. Servers store BCrypt password hashes; persisted client tokens use Android Keystore encryption. Account, sync and feedback data remain until account deletion; sessions last at most 30 days. Feedback content and optional contact details are sent for handling.

AI requires consent for each submission. Text passes through our server to the provider shown in the app. Our server does not persist inputs or outputs; results remain in app memory. Daily attempt counts remain until account deletion. The operator must explain provider retention, processing region and deletion before enabling AI. Cancellation may still count. Avoid unnecessary sensitive information.

Current web QR/PDF tools process files locally without uploading them. Loading pages needs connectivity. Confirmed external links and chosen sharing recipients follow their own policies. Rate-limit counts expire; logs contain status, timing and trace IDs without passwords, tokens or sensitive text. Container logs rotate at three 10 MB files.

Disable sync, revoke camera access, clear history/recents or remove favorites. Disabling sync does not delete cloud data. In My account, confirm deletion using email and password to remove the account, sessions, cloud favorites/recents/settings, feedback and AI counts, plus this device’s account sync partition. The website https://tool.zhzgo.cn/account/delete/ also supports deletion without the app. Deletion is permanent. Sign in again to check an uncertain network result.

Anonymous data, other-device copies and exported files require local removal. Clear app storage or uninstall; remove exported files through Photos/Files. Backup rules exclude cloud and device transfer; manufacturer behavior may vary. Recovery backups expire within a 30-day maximum. Restoration must merge the latest deletion ledger (old account ID and time only) to prevent account resurrection.

Contact the email above for access, correction, export, deletion or provider deletion requests. Never send passwords or tokens. Provider deletion depends on the configured service’s capabilities. Production traffic uses HTTPS; secrets remain server-side. Policy changes and new consent requirements will be disclosed. Crash diagnostics show up to 10 local times/types from the last 7 days without exception text, system traces or automatic uploads. Copy or clear locally; OS records cannot be deleted by the app.

Full policy: https://tool.zhzgo.cn/privacy/.

Phone sensors can differ from professional meters. Obstruction, orientation and sensor range affect results; environment labels are approximate. lx means lux; fc means foot-candles (1 fc ≈ 10.764 lx).
